publicationEvidence.contentReview: Internal independent reviews covered requirements, device/process integration, numerical-model, QA, accessibility, security/licensing, and documentation; no release-blocking P0/P1 findings remain. The thermal diffusion activity is an illustrative constant-dilute Arrhenius/Gaussian model with analytical checks only, not validation against silicon or foundry data. Accessible secondary sources support the cited Arrhenius pair; the exact original Sze (1983)/Scotten (2000) page or table provenance remains unresolved (P2) and is disclosed. A separate security review identified a pre-existing public commit-metadata author-email exposure (P3); it is left unchanged because mitigation would require rewriting public history.
publicationEvidence.siteVerification: The v1.0.0 content release passed Actions run 38211639092 and deployed successfully as deployment 7007733961 at release revision dac0f2401da47fa8a858ab3e2c7e24ad4e86fa84. A tag-ref dispatch (run 38211771673; deployment record 7007756862) passed validation, but its deploy job failed before any steps: the github-pages environment's custom branch policy permits only main, and the failed record has no environment URL; production was unchanged. README-only main revisions e22df2d06d5ac4d9a8266815f5ca61b8bae63ffb (run 38223134179 / deployment 7009664374) and 7c1fbd44e4993b61c6eeb3fe6e11eaec1c213577 (run 38224499133 / deployment 7009898448) deployed successfully; the latter is the current Pages source and neither changes files under site/. Production Playwright passed 8/8 desktop/tablet/mobile journeys for the v1.0.0 content, and all 41 static files returned HTTP 200.
publicationEvidence.chapterVerification: After current Pages deployment 7009898448 at revision 7c1fbd44e4993b61c6eeb3fe6e11eaec1c213577, both language entry pages and all 26 English and Korean chapter URLs returned HTTP 200 with nonempty bodies.
publicationEvidence.experimentVerification: All three experiment anchors were checked against original v1.0.0 deployment revision dac0f2401da47fa8a858ab3e2c7e24ad4e86fa84 and rechecked against current Pages revision 7c1fbd44e4993b61c6eeb3fe6e11eaec1c213577 on 2026-10-12. Both checks returned HTTP 200 with exact fragments present and the same response SHA-256; structured verification records the current revision.
